title: Inspect an authorized aftermath from its system
description: Four independently authenticated commanders use real fleet controls after100 earned ticks. An escape and rival route produce actual orbital loss and retained surface control. Both recipients open their own immutable report from the selected system, restore context and inspect current surface through reload. Fixed catalogue/domain clocks are explicit harness controls; budgets are220 ticks,240 seconds and24 captures per viewport. Rules remain under review; this does not certify managed encryption or hosted scheduling.
